name: benethos-mailbox-mcp
description: MCP server that gives AI agents your mailboxes through mailbox-service, within its token's rights.
long_description: Gives Claude your mailboxes through mailbox-service, a service you run yourself: search and read mail, see what is new, look at attachments, sort, write drafts and send. The service decides what the token may do. It holds no mail password, and the mail stays between Claude and your service.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The mail accounts you may use: id, address and what you may do there (read, write, drafts, send, share).

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: The folders of an account: id, name, role (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive, all) and counts.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one mail: headers, attachment ids and the body as plain text, cut to max_chars.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a conversation: its mails in every folder, oldest first, each as plain text.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: What changed since an earlier call: mail created, updated (moved, flags) or deleted, oldest first, ids only.

tools.name: share_attachment
tools.description: Share an attachment with another service that fetches the file itself, so it does not pass through you: a URL that service can fetch once, without a token, until it ends.

tools.name: update_messages
tools.description: Change mail of one account: mark read or unread, star, move, archive, label, add and remove keywords, or put into the trash.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in an account.

tools.name: update_folder
tools.description: Rename a folder or move it, with the mail and folders inside.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: The drafts of an account, newest first.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Write a draft into the drafts folder.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Replace a draft as a whole: what is left out is gone afterwards, attachments too unless keep_attachments names them.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft as it is stored.

service_token.title: Token
service_token.description: An API token of mailbox-service, made on a user's page in its UI. The server acts with that user's rights.

allow_http.title: Plain http to another machine
allow_http.description: Send the token unencrypted to a service on another machine. Not needed for localhost or https. Leave off and use https there.
